About us

Behind the reels.

We capture the moments you’re busy living.

What we do

The Reel Wala offers event shoots and reel editing for weddings, birthdays, festivals, college events and corporate gatherings. Our creators capture the occasion; our editors shape it into a reel.

How we work

Share your date, location and occasion. The team confirms availability, coverage and pricing before a booking is final. Event shoots use an iPhone 16 or newer. Delivery and the final scope are confirmed with your booking.

Already have the clips?

Send three or four videos through our reel-editing flow and choose an editing style. An editor handles the cut, colour and music according to the agreed brief.

Create with us

Shoot events, develop your portfolio and work with our team. Visit the creator page for device requirements and the application process.

Photography credits

Service illustrations use licensed photographs by JeegzArt Photography, Tirth Jivani and Pavel Danilyuk. These photographs illustrate the services offered. The reel-editing artwork is an editorial illustration.
